script_text: Stop, Taurus, Venus is forcing a reckoning you cannot sweet-talk away. Jupiter in Leo trines Venus in Libra in your 6th House of Work, while the Sun in Scorpio opposes your Moon in your 7th House of Partnerships. Saturn in Aries squares your Sun from your 12th House, exposing hidden resentments before they poison a bond. If taken, a partner will test your loyalty over money and touch, so choose presence over control. If single, Venus attracts an earthy admirer through your daily work, so stay visible and polished. For money, Jupiter in your 4th House backs a home-based deal, restructuring, or signing before noon. Do not chase a quick gain in your 2nd House of Earnings; concrete, slow gains beat speculation. Blessing: an unexpected message late tonight could reopen a closed door in your 11th House of Wishes. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss Venus next.
